diff --git a/test/units/module_utils/facts/network/test_linux.py b/test/units/module_utils/facts/network/test_linux.py

@@ -0,0 +1,84 @@
+from __future__ import (absolute_import, division, print_function)
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+from units.compat.mock import Mock, call, patch
+
+from ansible.module_utils.facts.network.linux import LinuxNetwork, LinuxNetworkCollector
+
+
+def test_locally_reachable_ips_normalized_and_sorted():
+    module = Mock()
+    module.run_command.side_effect = [
+        (0, '\n'.join([
+            'local 192.168.1.25/24 dev lo scope host',
+            'broadcast 192.168.1.255 dev eth0 scope link',
+            'local 127.0.0.1/32 dev lo scope host',
+            'local 192.168.1.0/24 dev lo scope host',
+            'local 127.0.0.0/8 dev lo scope host',
+            'local invalid dev lo scope host',
+        ]), ''),
+        (0, '\n'.join([
+            'local 2001:0db8:0:0::1/64 dev lo',
+            'local ::1/128 dev lo',
+            'multicast ff00::/8 dev lo',
+            'local 2001:db8::/64 dev lo',
+        ]), ''),
+    ]
+
+    with patch('ansible.module_utils.facts.network.linux.socket.has_ipv6', True):
+        result = LinuxNetwork(module).get_locally_reachable_ips('/sbin/ip')
+
+    assert result == {
+        'ipv4': ['127.0.0.0/8', '127.0.0.1', '192.168.1.0/24'],
+        'ipv6': ['::1', '2001:db8::/64'],
+    }
+    assert module.run_command.call_args_list == [
+        call(['/sbin/ip', '-4', 'route', 'show', 'table', 'local'], errors='surrogate_then_replace'),
+        call(['/sbin/ip', '-6', 'route', 'show', 'table', 'local'], errors='surrogate_then_replace'),
+    ]
+
+
+def test_locally_reachable_ips_failed_family_keeps_other_family():
+    module = Mock()
+    module.run_command.side_effect = [
+        (0, 'local 127.0.0.1 dev lo scope host', ''),
+        (1, '', 'unsupported'),
+    ]
+
+    with patch('ansible.module_utils.facts.network.linux.socket.has_ipv6', True):
+        result = LinuxNetwork(module).get_locally_reachable_ips('/sbin/ip')
+
+    assert result == {'ipv4': ['127.0.0.1'], 'ipv6': []}
+    module.warn.assert_called_once_with('Unable to gather locally reachable ipv6 addresses')
+
+
+def test_locally_reachable_ips_without_ipv6():
+    module = Mock()
+    module.run_command.return_value = (0, 'local 127.0.0.1 dev lo', '')
+
+    with patch('ansible.module_utils.facts.network.linux.socket.has_ipv6', False):
+        result = LinuxNetwork(module).get_locally_reachable_ips('/sbin/ip')
+
+    assert result == {'ipv4': ['127.0.0.1'], 'ipv6': []}
+    assert module.run_command.call_count == 1
+
+
+def test_locally_reachable_ips_in_populate():
+    module = Mock()
+    module.get_bin_path.return_value = '/sbin/ip'
+    network = LinuxNetwork(module)
+    with patch.object(network, 'get_default_interfaces', return_value=({}, {})), \
+            patch.object(network, 'get_interfaces_info', return_value=({}, {'all_ipv4_addresses': [], 'all_ipv6_addresses': []})), \
+            patch.object(network, 'get_locally_reachable_ips', return_value={'ipv4': ['127.0.0.1'], 'ipv6': []}):
+        facts = network.populate()
+
+    assert facts['locally_reachable_ips'] == {'ipv4': ['127.0.0.1'], 'ipv6': []}
+    assert 'locally_reachable_ips' in LinuxNetworkCollector().fact_ids
+
+
+def test_locally_reachable_ips_without_ip_command():
+    module = Mock()
+    module.get_bin_path.return_value = None
+
+    assert LinuxNetwork(module).populate() == {'locally_reachable_ips': {'ipv4': [], 'ipv6': []}}
+    module.warn.assert_called_once_with('Unable to gather locally reachable IPs: ip command is unavailable')
